one_line: Collaborative document platform combining docs, spreadsheets, and apps (now Superhuman Docs).
auth_notes: REST API v1 uses Bearer API tokens; OAuth2 also supported for Packs. API base is coda.io/apis/v1; rate limits per user; some write endpoints return 202 with requestId for async completion.
self_serve_notes: API is free in both free and paid workspaces; any user can generate an API token in account settings. Doc creation requires Doc Maker/Admin role in the workspace.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Docs, pages, tables, columns, rows, formulas, controls, folders, permissions, publishing, analytics, automations.
api_surface.webhook_note: No general webhooks API; automations can be triggered via API endpoints.

existing_mcp.note: Docs explicitly mention the Superhuman Docs MCP server optimized for LLM usage.

evidence.note: Fetched text is the full Superhuman Docs API (formerly Coda) v1 reference confirming Bearer auth, endpoint breadth, rate limits, and MCP server.

agent_notes: Coda was acquired by Superhuman; docs now branded 'Superhuman Docs' but API and docs URL remain coda.io.
